The last four years have felt like a dream. A messy, unpredictable one, but still a dream.

For a while now, we’ve been trying to piece together our own story. And putting it together, we found so much we’d forgotten ourselves. The early days, how we found new opportunities. How much we experimented, how much of it didn’t work, and how somewhere in all of that, a handful of us in a small flat became this video-obsessed ecosystem of 500 people.

This video is our attempt to show you some of that. 

Many of you have been here since the very beginning, through every channel, every experiment, every version of us. Thank you for staying. None of this would be possible without you!
